frontMatter.value: Build a "product description" repo for a software product — a set of prose documents describing, from the outside in, what the user sees, what they can do, and exactly what happens when they do it, written from the code and tests, then verified against the running product and triaged into a bug list. Works for any product with a user (canvas editors, web apps, CLIs, chat products, mobile apps). Use when the user asks to "write a product description for X", "describe the user experience of X", "document how X behaves for the user", "make a behavior-spec repo", or wants a feature-by-feature, event-by-event account of an app's behavior rather than API docs. Also use to resume or extend an existing product description repo.

passages.text: product-description is an extra start, installed on request, for an owner who wants how the product behaves for its user described feature by feature. It runs a standing program in a repository of its own, outside this one, so it opens no change record here. Before it starts, say what it will build, where, and whether it would spend fresh agents, and wait for the owner's yes. A repair its triage finds, once the owner takes it up, becomes a change proposed and run on the line from `frame`, its record's `## start` section naming product-description and the triage entry it handed on. It runs on a shipped surface, as reconnaissance before a change is framed or after one is verified, to describe what shipped. Driving the product in the verification pass follows the verify step's pages for a CLI and a UI, the proof of a single claim is the verify step's, and a state chart that outgrows a Mermaid block is `diagram-design`'s (extra).
passages.reason: One opening paragraph in the start's own voice: the situation the block's start table keys it by, that it works in a repository of its own and waits for the owner's yes, that a repair it hands on becomes a change run from frame with its start section, where it runs, and the step and the habit that own the verification and the durable chart. Re-cut at S18b onto the change record, in place of an initiative, its ticket and the retired names verify-this, control-cli and control-ui.

```
README.md            purpose, conventions, document template, method, structure, coverage table
goal.md              the standing instructions for whoever drafts (you, a delegated agent, a future session)
glossary.md          the vocabulary; the source of truth for every term of art
AGENTS.md            "Read README.md, then goal.md. The coverage table in README.md is the work list."
{area}/{feature}.md  one document per feature, all on the same skeleton
verification/        README.md (protocol) + one checklist file per cluster of documents
bug-triage.md        every suspected defect, deduplicated, with repro, cause, severity, decision needed
```
